cycle.probeScript:
local fails = 0
local function check(name, ok, detail)
  if ok then log("[VRF] PASS " .. name .. (detail and (" " .. tostring(detail)) or ""))
  else fails = fails + 1 log("[VRF] FAIL " .. name .. (detail and (" " .. tostring(detail)) or "")) end
end
local encounter = _GreatVoyageEncounterData
local data = _GreatVoyageVoyageData
local stateLogic = _GreatVoyageVoyageState
check("logic_ready", encounter ~= nil and data ~= nil and stateLogic ~= nil)
if encounter ~= nil and data ~= nil and stateLogic ~= nil then
  local monsters = encounter:GetAllMonsters()
  local badda = nil
  for _, m in ipairs(monsters) do if m.packId == "mob/2230109.img" then badda = m break end end
  check("badda_fixed_stats", badda ~= nil and badda.maxHp == 120 and badda.attackDamage == 12 and badda.bounty == 100,
    badda and ("hp="..tostring(badda.maxHp).." atk="..tostring(badda.attackDamage).." bounty="..tostring(badda.bounty)) or "missing")
  local t0 = encounter:GetShipTier(0)
  local t1 = encounter:GetShipTier(1)
  check("tier_caps", t0 ~= nil and t1 ~= nil and t0.maxLevel == 30 and t1.maxLevel == 50,
    "T0="..tostring(t0 and t0.maxLevel).." T1="..tostring(t1 and t1.maxLevel))
  local ports = data:GetPortIds()
  local mapPorts = data:GetMapPortIds()
  check("port_catalog_13_available", #ports == 13 and #mapPorts == 14, "available="..tostring(#ports).." mapped="..tostring(#mapPorts))
  local global = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 0, 0, {}, false)
  local globalOnly = #global.candidates > 0
  for _, candidate in ipairs(global.candidates) do
    if candidate.definition.area ~= "__allair" then globalOnly = false end
  end
  check("open_sea_only_global", globalOnly, "candidates="..tostring(#global.candidates))
  local localPrep = encounter:Prepare("rien", 5, 0, 0, {}, false)
  local localFound, sharedFound = false, false
  for _, candidate in ipairs(localPrep.candidates) do
    if candidate.definition.area == "rien" then localFound = true end
    if candidate.definition.area == "__allair" then sharedFound = true end
  end
  check("local_plus_global_candidates", localFound and sharedFound, "local="..tostring(localFound).." global="..tostring(sharedFound))
  local cargo0 = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 0, 0, {}, false)
  local cargo200k = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 200000, 0, {}, false)
  check("cargo_value_affects_encounter", cargo200k.chance >= cargo0.chance and cargo200k.countMax >= cargo0.countMax,
    "chance0="..tostring(cargo0.chance).." chance200k="..tostring(cargo200k.chance))
  local lure = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 0, 100, {}, false)
  local stealth = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 0, 0, {encounterMultiplier=-0.5}, false)
  check("decoy_stealth_parameters", lure.chance > cargo0.chance and stealth.chance < cargo0.chance,
    "base="..tostring(cargo0.chance).." lure="..tostring(lure.chance).." stealth="..tostring(stealth.chance))
  local sameA = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 1000, 0, {}, false)
  local sameB = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 1000, 0, {}, false)
  check("no_cash_parameter_deterministic", sameA.chance == sameB.chance and sameA.totalWeight == sameB.totalWeight,
    "cash is not an input to Prepare")
  local forced = encounter:Prepare("open_sea", 5, 0, 0, {}, false)
  forced.chance = 0
  local wave = encounter:DrawWave(forced)
  check("drawwave_no_chance_gate", #wave > 0, "n="..tostring(#wave).." preparedChance=0")
  local progression = data:GetShipProgression()
  local t5 = progression[6]
  local t5quote = data:GetRepairQuote({id="flagship",tier=5,maxHull=30000,hull=15000,maxShield=6000,shield=3000,maxArmor=12000,armor=6000,stats={}})
  local t1quote = data:GetRepairQuote({id="sloop",tier=1,maxHull=100,hull=99,maxShield=0,shield=0,maxArmor=0,armor=0,stats={}})
  local t0quote = data:GetRepairQuote({id="small_sampan",tier=0,maxHull=100,hull=0,maxShield=0,shield=0,maxArmor=0,armor=0,stats={}})
  check("t5_progression", t5 ~= nil and t5.price == 2147483647 and t5.combat.cannonDamage == 4000,
    "price="..tostring(t5 and t5.price).." cannon="..tostring(t5 and t5.combat and t5.combat.cannonDamage))
  check("repair_quotes", t5 ~= nil and t5.fullRepair == 50000000 and t5quote == 25000000 and t1quote == 50 and t0quote == 0,
    "T5="..tostring(t5quote).." T1="..tostring(t1quote).." T0="..tostring(t0quote))
  local bountyState = {airBattle=nil,pendingBounty=0,bountyCredit=0,money=1000,economyRevision=0}
  local bountyBattle = {settled=false,kills=0,bounty=0}
  local bountyEnemy = {id="mob/2230109.img",hp=0,bounty=100,claimed=false,uid=1}
  bountyState.airBattle = bountyBattle
  local first = stateLogic:ClaimMonsterBounty(bountyState,bountyBattle,bountyEnemy)
  local second = stateLogic:ClaimMonsterBounty(bountyState,bountyBattle,bountyEnemy)
  check("bounty_claim_deduped", first == true and second == false and bountyState.pendingBounty == 100,
    "first="..tostring(first).." second="..tostring(second).." pending="..tostring(bountyState.pendingBounty))
  local capState = {money=2147483640,pendingBounty=500,bountyCredit=0,economyRevision=0}
  stateLogic:SettleMonsterBounties(capState)
  local capMoney, capCredit = capState.money, capState.bountyCredit
  stateLogic:SettleMonsterBounties(capState)
  check("wallet_cap_carries_credit", capMoney == 2147483647 and capCredit == 493 and capState.money == capMoney and capState.bountyCredit == capCredit,
    "money="..tostring(capState.money).." credit="..tostring(capState.bountyCredit))
  local fixture = setmetatable({}, {__index=stateLogic})
  local publishCount = 0
  fixture.PublishSnapshot = function(self, playerId, battleState)
    publishCount = publishCount + 1
    log("[VRF] fixture publish intercepted complete_state=true player_id=fixture")
  end
  local enemies = {}
  for i=1,5 do enemies[i]={uid=i,id="mob/2230109.img",name="fixture-"..tostring(i),hp=120,maxHp=120,damage=12,interval=2,bounty=100,claimed=false,active=false,nextAttackAt=100} end
  local battle={id="fixture-airbattle",phase="active",outcome="",airspaceId="open_sea",enemies=enemies,kills=0,bounty=0,
    screenLimit=2,playerDamage=4000,playerAttackIntervalSeconds=0.6,flightSeconds=0.6,playerShotSequence=0,enemyShotSequence=0,
    nextPlayerAttackAt=60,startedAt=0,segmentIndex=1,settled=false}
  local battleState={status="sailing",ship={id="flagship",tier=5,hull=30000,maxHull=30000,shield=6000,maxShield=6000,armor=12000,maxArmor=12000,
    cannonMultiplier=1,stats={}},airBattle=battle,pendingBounty=0,money=1000,lastReason="",hullDamage=0}
  fixture:RefreshBattleRoster(battle,0)
  local active=0
  for _,enemy in ipairs(enemies) do if enemy.active then active=active+1 end end
  local mixedOk=true
  for i,enemy in ipairs(enemies) do if enemy.id ~= "mob/2230109.img" or enemy.hp ~= 120 then mixedOk=false end end
  check("fixture_roster_cap_mixed5", active==2 and #enemies==5 and mixedOk and battleState.money==1000 and battleState.pendingBounty==0,
    "active="..tostring(active).." total="..tostring(#enemies).." cannon=4000 money=1000 pending=0")
  fixture:AdvanceAirBattle("fixture_player",battleState,61)
  check("no_timeout_auto_win_alive", battle.phase=="active" and battle.kills==0 and battleState.ship.hull==30000 and publishCount==1,
    "phase="..tostring(battle.phase).." kills="..tostring(battle.kills).." publish="..tostring(publishCount))
end
log("[VRF] PROBE_COMPLETE failures="..tostring(fails))
